content: Seitani Yesu ꞌitohoꞌasaeya
Coinega Yaluyaluwa Tabuna Yesu ꞌilohemaheya, ma Yolidaniyega Yesu ꞌitoeya ma ꞌitauyeya tupwa yoho ꞌawawa.
Sabwelo poti ꞌoidiya Seitani ꞌitoho waiwai ma ꞌabehega Yesu ꞌiꞌabihebeꞌu, ma sabwelowedi ꞌoidiya Yesu geya ꞌiꞌai tohona, ma ꞌoinega ꞌigomaleya madouna.
Ma Seitaniina Yesu ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Ceguma ꞌowa Yehoba Natuna, daꞌule bewa ꞌuloinaedi ma siheꞌeꞌahai.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌalona loina ꞌimiyamiya ꞌabehega ‘Tomota yawasidi geya ꞌeꞌahaimo ꞌoinega sida lobeya.’”
Coinega Seitani Yesu ꞌitoe haneheya ma baleꞌu ꞌina ꞌebeloinao mabwaiyana ꞌiheꞌiteya tutaina nage ꞌoina, ma ꞌigwaeya,
“Bewa ꞌebeloina wasawasaedi mabwaiyadi yaꞌebwaego, ꞌeguma ꞌoiguwa ꞌuꞌetuluha. Weyahina mabwaiyanaina tuwa ꞌigu ꞌebeloina. Ma ꞌeguma taiya ꞌoina nuwanuwagu ma yaꞌebwae, tuwa yaꞌebwae.”
Ma Yesu ꞌigwaeya, “Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌalona loina ꞌimiyamiya, ꞌigwae, ‘Cino Bada Yehobamo ꞌoina ꞌuꞌetuluha ma ꞌiboimo ꞌenana ꞌuhematamatanedi.’”

Coinega Seitani Yesu ꞌitoe hileya ma ꞌitauyeya Yelusalema ma Hada Heꞌasisi tabwa sehenina ꞌihaneheya ma ꞌoina ꞌihegwaeya, ꞌigwae, “Ceguma ꞌowa Yehoba Natuna, bewa ꞌoinega ꞌuulataheya ma gesowana ꞌusilasilahe,
weyahina Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌihepwaila pwaiya, ꞌigwae, ‘Yehoba ꞌina aneloseyao ꞌiloinaedi ma siꞌitayahigo.’
Ma ꞌaigeda ꞌina hepwaila ꞌigwaeya, ‘Cino aneloseyao siꞌahaligo ma ꞌoinega gesowana ꞌaheu sisilasilae daꞌule ꞌoidiya.’”
Ma Yesu gwaeina ꞌihemaiseya ꞌigwae, “Caigeda wete gwae Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌoina ꞌimiyamiya, ꞌigwaeya, ‘Sahena ꞌino Bada Yehoba ꞌutohotoho.’”
Ma ꞌoinega Seitani ꞌina tohona mabwaiyana Yesu ꞌoina ꞌilosalohiya, ta ꞌiꞌebesineya, ma hali tuta ꞌoina ꞌida hilama.
Yesu ꞌina paihowa Galili ꞌoina ꞌihegaineya
Eeta Yesu Yaluyaluwa Tabuna ꞌina waiwaiyega ꞌihila Galili. Ma nage ꞌoina tetelina ꞌilelewana Galili tupwainao ꞌoidiya,
weyahina meGaliliyedi ꞌidi hada tapwalolo ꞌoidiya ꞌiloguloguguya, ma ꞌoinega mabwaiyadi siꞌahwa bwebweꞌaneya.
Ma muliyetega Yesu ꞌinaoma Nasaleta ꞌoina, tauna nage ꞌina gogo moisa. Ma Sabati ꞌoina Yesu ꞌiluhuwa hada tapwalolowa, mumugana gidemusa. Coinega ꞌitoholowa ma Buki Heꞌasisi ꞌihasili,
ꞌoinega palopita Aiseya ꞌina lele siꞌebwaeya, ta ꞌiyahaliya ma hasilaina ꞌilobeya, ꞌigwaeya,

content.text: “Bada Yaluyaluwana ꞌoiguwa ꞌimiyamiya. Tauna ꞌihesinuwegauwa ma towewelohe ꞌoidiya tetela bwebweꞌana yaguguyae.
Ma paipaidi wete ꞌoidiya ꞌihesumanegauwa ma ꞌadi lihasa weyahina yahepwaila.
Ma tomata gibugibu wete matadi ꞌidi ꞌasilala hila weyahina yahepwaila.
Ma wete ꞌihesumanegauwa ma tomiya mwau ꞌadi ꞌalehao nimadiyega yaꞌetolihasidi.
Ma yahepwaila wete bolimeina ꞌabwa Bada ꞌiꞌabihetegomi.”

content: Ma Yesu leleyedi ꞌihasili pwaidiya ta ꞌinupilidiya, ꞌoinega buki ꞌana toꞌitayahina ꞌiꞌebwae hileya, ma ꞌimiyatoiya. Ma tohenonowedi mabwaiyadi nuwadi ꞌiꞌeweya, ꞌoinega simiyamiya ta siꞌeꞌebubu.
Coinega ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Gwae bewa yahasila pwaiya ta wahesagoheya, mwalo sihepwaila nugeteya, ma bewa tutaina ꞌilatu pwaima.”
Ma taudi nuwadi ꞌihenainaida moisa, ꞌoinega ꞌina gwaeyedi bwebweꞌadi weyahidi sihepwatuweya, sigwae, “Loheya bewa Yosepa natuna, ꞌawa? Ma togidega hede?”

Coinega ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Hesi yasanapugomiya weyahina nata gwae hegehegediyega wahegwaegau ma wagwae, ‘Cowa toꞌabihe bwebweꞌana, ꞌoinega ꞌuboi ꞌuꞌabihe bwebweꞌanigo.’ Ma wete nata ꞌimi gwae ꞌaigeda ꞌoinega wahegwaegau ma wagwae, ‘Paihowaedi waiwaidi gogo Kapaneumi ꞌoina ꞌupaihowediya, gide wete ꞌupaihowa ꞌesedi ꞌebwa ꞌida gogo bewa ꞌoina.’
Ma yahegwae bwaibwainigomi ꞌabehega geya ꞌaigeda palopita ꞌina bodao ꞌoidiyega ꞌana heꞌasisi ꞌiloba.

Ma wanuwatuhuyahi ꞌabehega mwalo palopita Ilaitiya ꞌina tuta, hiwahiwape baibaiwadi Isileli ꞌoina simiyamiya, ma Yehoba geya Isileli wahineina ꞌihesinuwe ma Ilaitiya ꞌiꞌitayahi tutaina gomale madouna, weyahina bolime ꞌetoi ma tupwana ꞌoidiya geya ꞌwesu,
ma hesi ꞌaigeda hiwape Salepati ꞌoinega Yehoba ꞌihesinuwaneya Ilaitiya ꞌana ꞌitayahina weyahina, beno Saidoni tupwaina, ma Yehoba Ilaitiya ꞌihewasaeya hiwapeina ꞌina gogowa, ta ꞌiꞌitayahiya.

Ma palopita Ilaisa wete ꞌina tuta ꞌoina tolepelo baibaiwadi Isileli ꞌoina simiyamiya, ma geya ꞌaigeda taiya ꞌoidiyega ꞌiꞌabiꞌabi hebwebweꞌane, ma hesi ꞌaigedamo gwama Siliya ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya sanina Nemani.”
Yesu ꞌina gwaeyedi bewa ꞌoidiyega taudi totapwalolowedi ꞌiꞌabihe gamwasowalidiya,
ꞌoinega sitoholowa ma Yesu siꞌabiyahiya ma ꞌasega sitoe latuheya ma sitauyeya ꞌidi ꞌasa ꞌoyaina ꞌoina, ma ꞌoyaina debana silaguya ma ꞌabehega sihasepale dobihe ꞌadeꞌadewala.
Ma tauna bodaedi ꞌihaupediya ma ꞌitauya.
Yesu ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌaneya hiꞌahiꞌa ꞌoinega
Ma muliyetega ꞌidobiya Kapaneumi ꞌoina, beno Galili tupwaina, ta nobwa Sabatiya tomota ꞌiheꞌitediya.
Ma tomota mabwaiyadi nuwadi ꞌihenainaida weyahina ꞌina heꞌita mabwaiyana waiwaina.
Ma hada tapwaloloina ꞌoina ꞌaigeda loheya ꞌimiyamiya, ma loheyaina ꞌoina hiꞌahiꞌa* mwalo ꞌiluhuwa ta ꞌimiyamiya, ꞌoinega loheyaina ꞌenana madounega ꞌibwauwa ꞌigwae,
“Ya! Yesu ꞌowa gwama Nasaleta, toꞌaha lamuna ta ꞌunaoma ꞌoima? Nuwanuwau ꞌabehega ꞌumutumai, ꞌawa? Ma ꞌowa hesi yasanapugowa, ꞌowa tuwa Yehoba Natuna.”

Ma Yesu ꞌiloinaeya ma ꞌigwae, “Culolagu, ma loheya beno ꞌoinega ꞌulatu.” Ta dumwadumwaluna boda matadiya hiꞌahiꞌaina loheya ꞌiulaeya baleꞌuwa ta ꞌoinega hiꞌahiꞌa ꞌihapwesa, ma geya ꞌaigeda hesilae loheyaina ꞌiloba.
Coinega mabwaiyadi sisalutuwama, ma siboidimo sihesilalediya, sigwae, “Togidega hede bewa? Ma gwaemo ꞌina waiwai ꞌoinega hiꞌahiꞌa ꞌiloinaediya ta sihapwesa.”
Eeta Yesu tetelina silelewaneya Galili tupwainao ꞌoidiya.
Yesu tolohala baibaiwadi ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌanediya
Coinega Yesu Hada tapwalolowega ꞌilatuma, ma Saimoni ꞌina hada ꞌiluhuwa. Ma Saimoni lawana wahi yahiyahi ꞌoinega ꞌilohala, ꞌoinega Yesu siꞌahwanoiyeya ma ꞌiꞌabihe bwebweꞌane.
Coinega Yesu ꞌiluhuwa, ma ꞌina ꞌebeꞌenoina deina ꞌitoholowa, ta lohalaina ꞌiloineya ma ꞌina lohalaina ꞌisawala, ꞌoinega wahineina ꞌitoholo ta ꞌadiwa ꞌiꞌatububuya.
Ma hesi sinala ꞌisopu pwaiya, ma tomota ꞌidi tolohalao ꞌadi lohalao hagadi ma hagadi sitoedima Yesu ꞌoina, ta mabwaiyadi ꞌaigeda ꞌaigeda ꞌiꞌabitohodiya ta sibwebweꞌana.

Ma wete tupwana baibaiwadi ꞌoidiyega hiꞌahiꞌa silatulatu ma siwuiwui, sigwaeya, “Moisa ꞌowa Yehoba Natuna!” Ma Yesu ꞌiꞌausidiya ma sahena gide sigwaegwae ꞌesa, weyahina sisanapu pwaiya ꞌabehega tauna Toꞌabihetenaina Yehoba ꞌoinega.
Yesu ꞌiguguya sakowasiya

Ma gona ꞌiꞌadale pwaiya, ta Yesu gogoina ꞌiꞌebesineya, ma ꞌiboinamo yoho ꞌawawa ꞌitauya. Ta tomota baibaiwadi sihegaina ma ꞌabehega Yesu sibese, ma tutaina silobeya sihegwaeya, sigwae, “Sahena ꞌutautauya. Cebwa tuwa tamiyamiya.”
Coinega ꞌihegwaediya, ꞌigwae, “Tupwana wete gogo ꞌoidiya yatautau ma Yehoba ꞌina loina tetelina yaguguyae. Bewa tetelaina weyahina ma Yehoba ꞌihewasaegauma.”
Eeta ꞌilatuwa ma ꞌitauya Yudiya tupwanao mabwaiyadi ꞌoidiya, ma ꞌidi hada tapwalolo ꞌalodiya ꞌiguguya sakowasiya.
